original_text: Harrisburg, Pa. — Pennsylvania sent out 1,823,148 mail-in ballots during the 2020 election but received back approximately 2.5 million, according to state records. The discrepancy amounts to nearly 700,000 ballots that cannot be accounted for. The figure was first raised in a November 2020 Pennsylvania Senate Republican hearing, where former New York Mayor Rudy Giuliani said the numbers proved widespread fraud. “You sent out 1.8 million and got back 2.5 million,” Giuliani said. “That is not a clerical error. That is fraud.” The claim was recirculated in February 2026 by the X account The SCIF, Elon Musk, and Donald Trump. Trump wrote on Truth Social that the numbers showed he won the 2020 election in a landslide.
